LanguageData.MST.makesSickThoughtComment: If enabled, the pawn will have the "Sick" mood thought (ThoughtWorker_Sick).
LanguageData.MST.makesAlertComment: Whether this hediff triggers medical alerts in the Health tab.
LanguageData.MST.everCurableByItemComment: Whether this hediff can be cured by medicine, biosculpter pods, medical abilities, etc.
LanguageData.MST.keepOnBodyPartRestorationComment: When a body part is restored via regeneration, hediffs without this flag are removed.
LanguageData.MST.forceRemoveOnResurrectionComment: This hediff is forcefully removed when the pawn is resurrected.
LanguageData.MST.preventsDeathComment: Prevents the pawn from dying from this hediff (won't die even if severity reaches lethal level).
LanguageData.MST.duplicationAllowedComment: Whether the pawn can have multiple instances of this hediff.
LanguageData.MST.canAffectBionicOrImplantComment: Whether this disease can affect bionic or implanted body parts. If disabled, it bypasses bionics.
LanguageData.MST.alwaysShowSeverityComment: Always display severity even when the hediff is not visible.
LanguageData.MST.organicAddedBodypartComment: Whether this added body part counts as organic (not mechanical/bionic), affects duplication mechanics.
LanguageData.MST.becomeVisibleComment: Whether this stage is visible in the health status UI.
LanguageData.MST.lifeThreateningComment: Whether this stage is lethal (can cause death at high enough severity).
LanguageData.MST.painFactorComment: Multiplier for pain received (1.0 is normal).
LanguageData.MST.totalBleedFactorComment: Multiplier for total bleed rate from all bleeding sources.
LanguageData.MST.naturalHealingFactorComment: Multiplier for natural healing speed. -1 means don't override.
LanguageData.MST.vomitMtbDaysComment: Mean time between vomiting events (in days). -1 disables.
LanguageData.MST.deathMtbDaysComment: Mean time between death events from this stage (in days). -1 disables.
LanguageData.MST.hungerRateFactorOffsetComment: Fixed offset to hunger rate (adds to the factor).
LanguageData.MST.restFallFactorOffsetComment: Fixed offset to rest fall rate (adds to the factor).
LanguageData.MST.fertilityFactorComment: Multiplier for the pawn's fertility, affecting pregnancy chance.
LanguageData.MST.severityGainFactorComment: Multiplier for natural severity increase rate.
LanguageData.MST.partEfficiencyOffsetComment: Fixed offset to body part efficiency, affecting part functionality.
LanguageData.MST.mentalBreakMtbDaysComment: Mean time between mental breaks (in days). -1 disables.
LanguageData.MST.blocksMentalBreaksComment: Prevents all types of mental breaks.
LanguageData.MST.overrideMoodBaseComment: Overrides the pawn's base mood level. -1 means don't override.
LanguageData.MST.opinionOfOthersFactorComment: Multiplier for the pawn's opinion of other pawns.
LanguageData.MST.forgetMemoryThoughtMtbDaysComment: Mean time between forgetting random memories (in days). -1 disables.
LanguageData.MST.preventVacuumBurnsComment: Prevents vacuum burns in space for the pawn.
LanguageData.MST.regenerationComment: [Anomaly] HP regenerated per game tick. -1 means not in use.
LanguageData.MST.showRegenerationStatComment: Whether to show the regeneration stat in stat displays.
LanguageData.MST.multiplyStatChangesBySeverityComment: When enabled, statOffsets/statFactors/capMods values are multiplied by current severity.
LanguageData.MST.statOffsetEffectMultiplierComment: A stat that multiplies statOffset values for this stage.
LanguageData.MST.statFactorEffectMultiplierComment: A stat that multiplies statFactor values for this stage.
LanguageData.MST.capacityFactorEffectMultiplierCommen: A stat that multiplies capacity modifier values for this stage.
LanguageData.MST.hediffGiversComment: Hediff givers that apply hediffs at this stage. Remove-only.
LanguageData.MST.mentalStateGiversComment: Mental state givers that may trigger mental breaks at this stage. Remove-only.
LanguageData.MST.injuryPropsComment: Whether InjuryProps sub-object exists. Fields below are only editable when true.
LanguageData.MST.addedPartPropsComment: Whether AddedBodyPartProps sub-object exists. Fields below are only editable when true.
LanguageData.MST.painPerSeverityComment: Pain generated per unit of severity.
LanguageData.MST.averagePainPerSeverityPermanentComme: Average pain per severity when the injury becomes permanent.
LanguageData.MST.canMergeComment: Whether this injury can merge with other injuries on the same body part.
LanguageData.MST.solidComment: Whether this added body part is solid (can be individually targeted and damaged).
LanguageData.MST.isGoodWeaponComment: Whether this added body part is considered a good melee attack weapon.
LanguageData.MST.betterThanNaturalComment: Whether this part is better than the natural body part (affects medical procedure behavior).
LanguageData.MST.severityPerDayTendedComment: Severity change per day when tended.
LanguageData.MST.tendAllAtOnceComment: If true, all tend quality is applied at once instead of over time.
LanguageData.MST.disappearsAfterTicksComment: Hours after which the hediff disappears.
LanguageData.MST.immunityPerDaySickComment: Immunity gain per day while sick.
LanguageData.MST.severityPerDayImmuneComment: Severity change per day while immune.
LanguageData.MST.removeOnRedressChanceByDaysCurveComm: Curve defining the chance to remove this hediff on redress by days since installation.
LanguageData.MST.disappearsAtTotalTendQualityComment: Total tend quality at which the hediff disappears. -1 = disabled.
LanguageData.MST.severityPerDayRangeComment: Random range of severity change per day (min~max). Added to severityPerDay.
LanguageData.MST.severityPerDayNotImmuneComment: Severity change per day when not immune.
LanguageData.MST.hasGetsPermanentComment: Toggle GetsPermanent comp. If enabled, this injury may become permanent.
LanguageData.MST.becomePermanentChanceFactorComment: Multiplier for the chance of this injury becoming permanent (default 1.0).
LanguageData.MST.hasGiveHediffComment: Toggle GiveHediff comp. If enabled, this hediff gives another hediff over time.
LanguageData.MST.giveHediffLabelComment: The hediff that will be given by this hediff.
LanguageData.MST.giveHediffAtSeverityComment: Severity at which the hediff is given.
LanguageData.MST.VerbGiverToolComment: Attack tools granted by this hediff (from VerbGiver comp). Click to jump to the tool editor.
LanguageData.MST.hasReactOnDamageComment: Toggle ReactOnDamage comp. If enabled, this hediff reacts when the pawn takes damage.
LanguageData.MST.reactOnDamageCreateHediffComment: The hediff to create on the pawn when they take damage.
